"""Environment check (dev seed 7, not a gate row): are the B3-day told facts stored as one block each and recalled at
once; which stretch sentences store nothing; how long does a turn and an idle tick take on numpy."""
import json
import os
import sys
import time

os.environ.setdefault("SIM_BACKEND", "numpy")
os.environ.setdefault("BRAIN_CHAT_RENDERER", "stub")
os.environ.setdefault("SIM_DISABLE_LLM", "1")
os.environ["BRAIN_CHAT_SEED"] = "7"
os.environ["BRAIN_LTM_SHIP_DEFAULT"] = "0"
os.environ["BRAIN_DA_TAG_CAPTURE"] = "1"
os.environ["BRAIN_DA_TAG_CAPTURE_CLOCK"] = "turn"
os.environ["BRAIN_SLEEP_REPLAY_CAPTURE"] = "1"
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from webapp.server import brain_chat, BrainChatRequest  # noqa: E402
from webapp import server as S, continuous_engine as CE  # noqa: E402

turns = [
    "the cat is here", "the ball is here", "the cat chases the ball", "the cat is here", "the ball is here",
    "what does the cat chase",
    "Guess what, something unbelievable happened at the circus today!",
    "You will never believe this crazy story, it is absolutely amazing!",
    "the dog stores the memory",
    "Everyone in the audience was screaming and laughing in total shock!",
    "Honestly it was the most astonishing spectacle anybody has ever witnessed!",
    "what does the dog store",
    "the bird is here", "the river is here", "the bird uses the river", "the bird is here", "the river is here",
    "what does the bird use",
    "the cat is here", "the ball is here", "the bird is here", "the river is here", "the dog is here",
    "the memory is here", "hello", "that is nice",
    "what does the cat chase", "what does the dog store", "what does the bird use",
    "you mentioned the cat", "you mentioned the dog", "you mentioned the bird",
]
out = []
for i, m in enumerate(turns):
    t0 = time.time()
    r = json.loads(brain_chat(BrainChatRequest(session="env", message=m, brain="tiny-demo", renderer="stub",
                                               rich=False, reset=(i == 0))).body)
    dt = time.time() - t0
    tc = r.get("da_tag_capture") or {}
    rec = {"i": i, "msg": m, "sec": round(dt, 2), "recalled_svo": r.get("recalled_svo"),
           "abstained": r.get("abstained"), "answer": (r.get("answer") or "")[:90],
           "da": ((r.get("da_drives") or {}).get("da_level")),
           "new_blocks": tc.get("new_blocks_this_turn"), "n_managed": tc.get("n_managed_blocks"),
           "episodic": (r.get("episodic") or None), "da_enc": r.get("da_encoding")}
    out.append(rec)
    print(json.dumps(rec, default=str), flush=True)
last = max(v for v in CE._LAST_REQUEST.values() if v is not None)
for lab, dt_s in (("idle20", 20.0), ("idle40", 40.0), ("sleep300", 300.0), ("sleep320", 320.0)):
    t0 = time.time()
    n = CE.tick_idle_sessions(S._SESSION_MOOD, S._get_affect_organ, now=last + dt_s,
                              selfinit_getter=S._get_selfinit_organ,
                              episodic_getter=S._get_episodic_organ_existing, chat_getter=S._get_chat_existing)
    print(json.dumps({"tick": lab, "sec": round(time.time() - t0, 3), "n": n}), flush=True)
json.dump(out, open(sys.argv[1], "w"), indent=1, default=str)
